sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 4.1.3: Status Messages
sources.released_version_or_commit: WCAG 2.2; explanatory page updated 2026-05-11; rolling page
sources.locator: SC 4.1.3, Intent, status-message examples, Other uses of live regions or alerts, Sufficient Techniques, Failures
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: When content changes without focus/context change and conveys success/result, waiting, progress, or errors, programmatic status semantics allow assistive technologies to present it without focus. The page cautions about excessive chatter and notes that this criterion does not require authors to generate new statuses. role=status is a sufficient technique for status/progress in listed situations; alert use is scoped to important/error cases.
sources.applicability: Pending validation and save status, async errors, and avoiding focus theft. It does not prescribe announcing every keystroke or each internal state transition.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 3.3.1: Error Identification
sources.locator: SC 3.3.1; intent; user-agent native HTML form validation discussion; ARIA21 and ARIA19 techniques
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: If an input error is automatically detected, identify the item and describe the error in text. The explanation says native browser messages can be generic/transient/small when zoomed and may expose only the first of several errors; evaluate browser/AT support.
sources.applicability: Use textual field errors and a find-all mechanism; do not rely on color or a generic browser bubble alone.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 3.3.3: Error Suggestion
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: When an error is automatically detected and a correction suggestion is known, provide it unless doing so would jeopardize security or the purpose of the content.
sources.applicability: Server validation errors should explain the unavailable choice and, when permitted, offer current allowed choices or an actionable next step.

sources.title: WAI Forms Tutorial: User Notification
sources.locator: In-line feedback, After submit, On focus change
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Recommends inline explanations and, on an unsuccessful form submission, focus on the first invalid input. It also shows an assertive live-region example for focus-change validation; this is an example, not a mandate for all asynchronous events.
sources.applicability: Supports an explicit submit/commit error-summary path and field-linked inline text. The assertive example is tempered by S01 and S05 for less urgent or frequent asynchronous results.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA APG Alert Pattern
sources.locator: About This Pattern; WAI-ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Dynamic alerts announce important messages without interrupting; they must not affect keyboard focus, should not disappear too quickly, and frequent interruptions can harm usability.
sources.applicability: Do not move focus on individual async replies; avoid transient alerts and uncontrolled per-field announcement bursts.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 2.4.3: Focus Order
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: If sequential navigation affects meaning or operation, focus order must preserve meaning and operability. It need not be identical to visual layout.
sources.applicability: Keep stable tab order and meaningful summary links as errors/status are inserted, including under reflow.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 1.4.10: Reflow
sources.locator: SC 1.4.10; Adjusting content into a single column; Resize Text overlap; Focus Not Obscured overlap
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Typical reading content should reflow to a 320 CSS pixel viewport and vertical reading; the page notes 200% text enlargement under SC 1.4.4 and exceptions for content whose meaning/function needs two-dimensional layout.
sources.applicability: Error summary, labels, messages, and field groups must wrap in narrow and zoomed layouts; target form content is ordinary service text, not an identified exception.

sources.title: W3C Internationalization: Structural markup and right-to-left text in HTML
sources.locator: Document direction; dir attribute; dynamically inserted and user-provided text
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Declare overall direction using dir; use dir=auto for forms and inserted/user text when direction is unknown.
sources.applicability: Use direction-aware structure and test bidirectional layout. This source says nothing about translation quality or compatibility with specific assistive technologies.

sources.title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics
sources.locator: §13.1.1 If-Match; §13.2.2 evaluation of preconditions; §15.5.13 412 Precondition Failed
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: If-Match is evaluated with strong entity-tag comparison and is commonly used on state-changing requests to prevent lost updates. A false condition means the method is not performed and may produce 412; a server may return success if it can determine the same change already succeeded.
sources.applicability: Use a canonical entity version/ETag on save. Treat 412 as conflict requiring refresh/review while preserving local dirty text. RFC does not specify the portal's product conflict UI or idempotency design.

sources.title: React Aria Forms guide
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current rolling documentation; no exact software version or commit stated on page
sources.locator: Validation; Constraint validation; Server validation; Schema validation; Localization; Form libraries
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Guide documents native constraints, custom/realtime validation, server field errors supplied through validationErrors, which clear after the user modifies the field. It says client checks are not a replacement for backend validation. Native behavior can prevent submit; aria behavior marks semantics without blocking submission.
sources.applicability: Maintained reference for field semantics and validation API. It does not document stale-request identity, multi-reviewer concurrency, save interruption reconciliation, multilingual testing, or a target-toolkit choice.

sources.title: React Spectrum issue #6830: React 19 Actions + RAC Form automatic reset
sources.released_version_or_commit: Issue reports RAC 1.3.1; opened 2024-08-05; closed by linked PR #8444
sources.locator: Issue description, expected/current behavior, version, linked PR
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct issue open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reporter observed React 19 action-driven automatic reset restoring original default values and clearing server validationErrors after response; report includes four browsers and a reproduction link.
sources.applicability: Concrete failure path for framework reset occurring after asynchronous server error/state update; scope is React 19 Actions plus RAC 1.3.1, not all form libraries.

sources.title: React Spectrum PR #8444: Support automatic reset after React 19 form actions
sources.released_version_or_commit: Merged 2025-07-07; commit effce79 (abbreviated ID shown on PR)
sources.locator: Merge header; maintainer notes on reset value and action validation errors; files changed
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct pull-request open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Fix synchronizes component internal state with the current defaultValue at reset and avoids clearing action-returned errors after framework automatic reset. Notes best-effort ignore of programmatic reset outside a user event because React provides no distinction.
sources.applicability: Fix history informs lifecycle regression tests and warns reset event classification is conditional; do not assume the fix resolves unrelated race or remote-conflict behavior.

sources.title: React Spectrum issue #6983: Native validation doesn't dismiss errors as user corrects them
sources.released_version_or_commit: Open at retrieval; opened 2024-08-30; reported version field says latest, not pinned
sources.locator: Current Behavior; Possible Solution; reproduction and browser fields; status
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct issue open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Reporter says native-mode error text does not update/clear until blur after correction, in Firefox/Chrome/Safari. This is a user report with unpinned release, not independently reproduced.
sources.applicability: Test correction/update timing explicitly; cite only as an open reported edge, not as proven behavior of a specific current release.

sources.title: GOV.UK Design System Error summary
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current page history records GOV.UK Frontend v6.2.0 (June 2026); v4.4.0 history entry dated November 2022
sources.locator: How it works; linking from summary; where to put summary; recent changes; v4.4.0 entry
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Always show summary with validation errors; on that error state, focus the summary, link each error to its field, and use same wording in summary and inline message. v4.4.0 moved role=alert inward and removed aria-labelledby after a JAWS issue.
sources.applicability: Useful alternative for find-all and explicit-submit recovery. Do not apply automatic summary focus to each late asynchronous result; keep current focus during background changes.

sources.title: GOV.UK Design System Error message
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current rolling documentation; paired design system page records Frontend v6.2.0 (June 2026)
sources.locator: When to use/not use; How it works; multilingual prefix example
sources.observed_operation: web search and direct page open
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Put text next to the question, programmatically associate it, preserve passing and failing values. Do not use an input-error pattern for eligibility, permission, service-capacity, or other service-side problems; the page gives a Welsh hidden-prefix example.
sources.applicability: Preserves user's explanation and separates form errors from service errors. The sample prefix is not evidence of translation quality or screen-reader compatibility.
